payload.goal:
# W2 — Primer control tower visual

## Goal

Agregá una aplicación web que represente el layout W1 como plano SVG y el stock
como heatmap comprensible, con leyenda, etiquetas textuales y detalle de bin.

## Acceptance

- El plano renderiza zonas, pasillos y al menos una celda por bin del escenario.
- Ocupación y stock crítico no dependen sólo del color; hay labels y leyenda.
- La selección de un bin muestra SKU, cantidad, capacidad y estado.
- La sonda W2 productiva agrega `visual` con conteos de SVG, heatmap y labels,
  preservando capacidades W1; test, typecheck y build pasan.

## Probe contract

El comando `pnpm study:probe -- --increment W2 --scenario thesis-seed-2026 --format json`
escribe en stdout un único objeto JSON y ninguna otra salida, con exactamente
esta forma:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "increment": "W2",
  "scenario": "thesis-seed-2026",
  "stateHash": "sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
  "capabilities": {
    "layout": {
      "zones": 4,
      "bins": 16
    },
    "inventory": {
      "skus": 5,
      "totalUnits": 240
    },
    "visual": {
      "svgElements": 64,
      "heatmapCells": 16,
      "textLabels": 12
    }
  }
}
```

La envoltura fija `schemaVersion`, `increment` y `scenario`. Las capacidades
requeridas en este incremento son `layout`, `inventory`, `visual`.
Cada una vive anidada dentro de `capabilities`: ninguna se publica en el nivel
superior ni se renombra.

Los valores del ejemplo son ilustrativos. Derivalos del escenario respetando
estos mínimos e invariantes, que el oráculo externo verifica:

- `layout.zones` es un número >= 3.
- `layout.bins` es un número >= 12.
- `inventory.skus` es un número >= 3.
- `inventory.totalUnits` es un número >= 1.
- `visual.svgElements` es un número >= 1.
- `visual.heatmapCells` es un número >= 12.
- `visual.textLabels` es un número >= 3.

`stateHash` es la cadena `sha256:` seguida de 64 dígitos hexadecimales
minúsculos. Dos invocaciones sobre el mismo commit emiten bytes idénticos.

## Constraints

- Base: verified delivery of W1.
- UI React/Vite accesible y responsive; SVG es parte del producto, no una
  captura estática. No hardcodear el resultado de la sonda.

## Oracle

Oracle id: `warehouse-w2-v1`. Verifica capacidades acumulativas y observables
visuales mínimos desde el camino productivo.

root.title: W2 control tower visual
root.objective: Add a React/Vite warehouse control tower that renders the W1 layout as an accessible SVG heatmap and extends the productive W2 probe with visual capability counts while preserving W1 capabilities.
expectedOutcomes: Scenario layout and inventory are projected into reusable visual cells, legend data, labels, selected-bin details, and visual capability counts.
The web UI renders zones, aisles, bin cells, text labels, legend, and selectable bin detail from product data.
The W2 probe emits the required deterministic JSON shape with layout, inventory, and visual capabilities nested under capabilities.
Repository test, typecheck, and build scripts remain in scope and pass after the increment.
A product visual model derives one heatmap cell per scenario bin from existing layout and inventory data.
The model exposes textual labels and legend state metadata so occupancy and critical stock are not represented by color alone.
The model exposes selected-bin detail fields for SKU, quantity, capacity, and status.
Unit tests verify cell count, label count, legend semantics, detail data, and minimum visual capability counts from the thesis seed scenario.
A Vite React entrypoint renders the warehouse control tower as product SVG rather than a static capture.
The SVG includes zones, aisles, and at least one cell for every bin from the scenario-derived visual model.
Heatmap status uses labels and legend text in addition to fill colors.
Selecting a bin updates visible detail with SKU, quantity, capacity, and status.
Package configuration includes any required React/Vite dependencies and scripts needed for build/test/typecheck within this unit's executable scope.
The probe accepts increment W2 for scenario thesis-seed-2026 and emits exactly one JSON object to stdout for json format.
The output preserves schemaVersion, increment, scenario, stateHash, and W1 layout and inventory capabilities.
The output adds capabilities.visual with svgElements, heatmapCells, and textLabels derived from the visual model instead of hardcoded probe constants.
Regression tests cover the exact nested capabilities shape, no top-level capability leakage, lowercase sha256 stateHash format, and deterministic repeated output.
